question: Amit bought some erasers at the rate of ₹150 a dozen. He sold them for ₹42 each. His profit percentage is ______%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost Price (CP) of 1 eraser = 150 ÷ 12 = ₹12.5

Selling Price (SP) of 1 eraser = ₹42

Profit % = [(SP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100

Profit % = [(42 − 12.5) ÷ 12.5] × 100

Profit % = (29.5 ÷ 12.5) × 100 = 236%

**∴ The correct answer is 236%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) of 1 dozen (12 erasers) = ₹150

Selling Price (SP) of 1 eraser = ₹42

**Formula Used:**

Profit = Selling Price (SP) − Cost Price (CP)

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 CP = ₹150
 (1 Dozen)
 
 
 SP = ₹504
 (12 × ₹42)
 
 
• 
 
 Profit = ₹354
 Profit % = 236%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Cost Price (CP) for 12 erasers = ₹150

⇒ Total Selling Price (SP) for 12 erasers = 12 × 42 = ₹504

⇒ Profit = Total SP − Total CP

⇒ Profit = 504 − 150 = ₹354

⇒ Profit % = (354 ÷ 150) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (354 ÷ 3) × 2

⇒ Profit % = 118 × 2 = 236%

**∴ The correct answer is 236%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP). Selling Price (SP) = MP − Discount.

Successive Discount

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are given on an item, the equivalent single discount is given by the formula: Equivalent Discount % = (a + b − ab ÷ 100)%.

Dishonest Dealer

If a dealer claims to sell his goods at the cost price but uses a false weight, his Profit % = (Error ÷ True Value − Error) × 100.
